ancestor_policy: Broad selectors were audited and retained; moved primitives no longer enter unrelated legacy objective/provider buckets. Retirement of broad Debian identity removes unsupported exceptions.
placement_passes: Matcher-first review: reads vs decompression, ranges vs RC4, properties vs AES, registry/name/request references vs intent
Consumer review: objectives retain required attack context; library identity and decoded-address controls tested separately

leaf_boundaries.data/buffer/read: Read buffered/stream data; does not imply decompression
leaf_boundaries.data/collection/array: Array initialization and value ranges; does not imply a cipher
leaf_boundaries.fs/directory/traverse: Recursive directory walks; distinguish single-directory listing
leaf_boundaries.crypto/cipher: Cipher mode properties only; algorithm not inferred
leaf_boundaries.crypto/library/cryptoapi: BCrypt API/provider references; algorithm not inferred
leaf_boundaries.os/registry/keys: Registry key/path reference, not a modification or bypass
leaf_boundaries.os/application/target: Application/product reference, not a network call
leaf_boundaries.communications/email/content: Mail body request content, not phishing intent

coverage_changes: Consolidate three shell-association command paths as neutral references; retain bypass context in consuming composites
Remove 0..255 range from RC4 state-table evidence and retire redundant stream-cipher loader composite
Dictionary shape exclusions prevent language/product/mailer assumptions
Require same-line commands, invoice request context, and EasyList title header
Split provider suffix alternatives into individually indexed literal domains; preserve original group IDs, decoded coverage and HTML comment exclusions
Canonical Packer parameter signature avoids malformed-tag comment parser; preserve HTML comment exclusion
Content-blocker bundle identity restricted to extension container/manifest types
external_mapping_policy: MBC and ATT&CK reviewed against each required observation; unsupported encryption and attack mappings removed. Historical migration JSON is not rewritten.
mapping_catalog_revision: No new ATT&CK/MBC mappings introduced. Original mappings are captured in definitions; unsupported mappings removed. Referenced ../src/mbc-markdown is outside the authorized search roots, so no catalog revision asserted.

post_validation_corrections.email: Existing HTML comment near-miss retained; literal domain prefixes bypass comment masking on unrelated wordlist text
post_validation_corrections.package_catalog: Existing inventory control now requires metadata/file/catalog/identity::python-package-name-list. Available package names are not dependency declarations. requirements.txt keeps dependency observations.
